components.name: Starwhale Fin
components.blurb: A fin the colour of the sea at night, cut from something that is not entirely finished being alive. It twitches when the ship turns. Do not name it.
components.quirk: Relic. Thrust 38 (a Concord Mk4 makes 36) for 4 power, and it heals itself 0.5 hp a second, its mount's outside half too, with no power and no crew: a fin that is knocked out grows back. It eats: the jump fuel of a ship flown on Fins is half as much again.
